overview_description.description:
Wordware was started with a simple thesis: words are the next programming language. Not software. Wordware.

Our main product is Sauna, an AI assistant built for compounding context. It learns your taste, detects hidden patterns, augments your brain context and works proactively so you can reclaim your deep work.
